verses.1: The wise women gave birth to their children in their homes, but with their hands, they destroyed them.
verses.2: He walks in righteousness, fearing the Lord. His ways are preserved and protected.
verses.3: In the mouth of a wolf, there is strength; and in the lips of the wise, their wisdom shall be preserved.
verses.4: In thousands of years, there will still be many people who will bring forth many offspring through their strength.
verses.5: Honest witnesses will not be deceived or misled like false witnesses.
verses.6: I seek wisdom, knowledge, and understanding for those who are wise.
verses.7: Go against a foolish man, knowing that your lips are full of ignorance.
verses.8: The wise man understands his own ways, while the foolish ones only see deceit in everything.
verses.9: May those who are evil be punished, and may those who are righteous be blessed.
verses.10: He who knows the joy of his soul and his happiness will not be deceived.
verses.11: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, and the temple of the righteous will flourish.
verses.12: There is a right path before a person, and another path that leads to destruction.
verses.13: Even in sorrow, the heart still suffers; but after that, joy will come.
verses.14: From his ways, a good heart will be filled with joy; and from him, a good person will come.
verses.15: He will believe in everything, and he will understand why.
verses.16: A wise person fears and avoids evil. A foolish person, on the other hand, is willing to do evil.
verses.17: A man who is weak will be punished, and anyone who seeks to do evil will be condemned.
verses.18: They suddenly became confused, and their minds became lost.
verses.19: Evil people should be put aside before the good ones. And sinners should be removed from the doors of the righteous.
verses.20: Even his enemies will praise him, and there are many who love him dearly.
verses.21: He is guilty of wrongdoing and commits evil deeds. His descendants are also wicked.
verses.22: May there be no harm or evil among those who are evil, and may there be only kindness and truth among those who are good.
verses.23: In all difficulties, it will be a matter of obedience and following God’s commands.
verses.24: The wise men were treated like fools, just like the foolish ones.
verses.25: He will save souls, but he will also deceive them like false prophets.
verses.26: In the sight of Jehovah, he will be protected from harm, and his children will be safe.
verses.27: The fear of Jehovah protects lives from the dangers of death.
verses.28: In the time of great suffering for the king, and in times of sorrow for his wife.
verses.29: My arms are long and thin, yet my mind is short-sighted.
verses.30: The lives of human beings are like a healing heart; they can also cause jealousy to arise within them.
verses.31: He made it smooth and polished; He adorned it with beauty.
verses.32: In his evil ways, the wicked will be rejected; in his death, the righteous will be saved.
verses.33: In the heart of a fool, wisdom lies hidden; but in the presence of fools, wisdom is revealed.
verses.34: Justice for the nations, and mercy for the people. Sin is a transgression.
verses.35: He wanted a wise servant as his king, and his words should be humble.
